src: Fees as published by each partner, Q4 2026: taker fee for a plain market buy. 21bitcoin charges its regular fee for the first 7 days of a plan. Invity and Crypto.com publish their fees on their own sites. Spreads and withdrawal fees not included.

pr_21bitcoin_body: Bitcoin-only app regulated by the Austrian FMA under MiCAR, with insured Bitcoin custody. Auto-Invest savings plan with 0% fees from day 8. Bank transfer and card supported.
pr_bybit_body: Bybit EU GmbH is MiCAR-licensed by the Austrian FMA, based in Vienna and serves the whole EEA. Spot taker fee 0.25%, maker fee 0.1%.
pr_bybit_f2: Based in Vienna, serves the EEA
pr_kraken_lic: Ireland · Central Bank of Ireland, MiCA
pr_kraken_body: Bitcoin exchange founded in 2011, MiCA CASP licensed via the Central Bank of Ireland and passported across the EEA. Kraken Pro taker fee 0.8% at the entry tier.
pr_kraken_f1: MiCA licence via the Central Bank of Ireland
pr_invity_body: Bitcoin-only app from the SatoshiLabs group, the makers of Trezor. Buy once or automatically with Auto Buy. Invity holds your Bitcoin with the custodian BitGo until you withdraw it to your own wallet, which you can do at any time.
pr_invity_f1: Licensed by the Czech National Bank
pr_cryptocom_body: Foris DAX MT Limited is MiCA CASP licensed by Malta's MFSA with EEA passporting. App with the Crypto.com Visa Card for spending from your balance.
